name: Gritblight

items.name: Blight Sense
items.text: A gritblight can detect the location of nearby creatures afflicted with Ayrzul's Blight as a precise sense at the listed range.

items.name: +1 Status to Saves vs. Earth Effects
Blight Cloud
items.text:
30 feet.

A gritblight continually sheds tiny fragments of radioactive earth in a cloud around it. This cloud conceals the gritblight as a light fog and sheds dim light in the area. Any creature that begins its turn in the aura takes 2d6 poison damage with a DC 30 basic Fortitude save save. A creature that fails its save is exposed to Ayrzul's Blight and a creature that critically fails is additionally Sickened 1.

items.name: Ayrzul's Blight
items.text:
Radioactive elemental energy courses through sap and blood, petrifies bark and bone, withers flesh, and mutates life. Creatures with the wood or plant trait treat critical successes against the disease as successes. The drained condition caused by Ayrzul's Blight can't be healed until the disease is removed. Ayrzul's Blight presents with obvious but varying symptoms, from coughing up black dust to suddenly becoming covered in itchy patches of flaky stone.

Saving Throw DC 33 Fortitude save

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 Drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 Drained 2 (1 day)

Stage 3 Drained 3 (1 day)

Stage 4 Drained 4 (1 day)

Stage 5 mutation (on a failure) or death (on a critical failure)

items.name: Earth Glide
items.text: The gritblight can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the gritblight moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

items.name: Grit Vision
items.text: A gritblight's vision is unaffected by clouds of sand, dirt, grit, or other earth materials in air or water.

items.name: Labyrinthine Vision
items.text:
The gritblight forces disorienting visions of Ayrzul's Blistering Labyrinth into the minds of nearby creatures. All creatures in a 60-foot cone take 7d12 mental damage with a DC 33 Will save save. Creatures Blinded by a gritblight's Labyrinthine Vision see only endless earthen tunnels in every direction.

The gritblight can't use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is blinded permanently.

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Medium or smaller, claw, DC 33 basic Reflex save

---

text: Resembling twisted lumps of fused gravel with oddly angled crystal limbs, gritblights are shock troops commonly used by Ayrzul to spread terror and disease to his enemies. These creatures are the gruesome result of experiments on crystalline elementals who were once the allies or servants of Ayrzul's rival lord of elemental earth, Sairazul. Their crystalline body parts appear cracked and deformed, only their single "eye" left intact.
